integrated_multimodal_description: [Production continuity] Live-action cinematic short film in one continuous rain-lit cafe scene. The same middle-aged East Asian man is the only speaking protagonist throughout the video. He has short black hair, a clean-shaven face, and wears a dark charcoal suit with a white shirt. Preserve his face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, voice identity, speaking style, and emotional state across every segment. Preserve the cafe layout, wooden furniture, rain-covered windows, warm tungsten lighting, muted amber and green color palette, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, and natural cinematic motion. Do not introduce a new character, location, time of day, costume, visual style, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, or other written text.

overall_soundscape: Continuous rain outside the cafe, quiet indoor room tone, subtle footsteps and clothing movement, and natural male speech. Keep the ambience, voice identity, loudness, and acoustic space continuous across all segments.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

segments.prompt: [Shot 1, opening] The man enters the rain-lit cafe and walks slowly from the entrance toward a table near the window. Begin with a stable medium-wide shot, then make a slow natural push-in to a medium shot. He looks toward the camera and starts speaking calmly in Chinese. His mouth remains visible and synchronized with the speech. <d>[Chinese] 雨下得比我想象中还要大。我们先进去说。</d>

[Shot 1, continuation] Continue directly from the exact final moment of the previous segment. Preserve the same man, cafe, lighting, weather, framing, and camera motion. The man remains near the table and continues speaking to the same off-camera conversation partner. The camera slowly follows him as he turns toward the rain-covered window. Do not cut to a new location or change his clothes. Keep his mouth visible and speech synchronized. <d>[Chinese] 我今天来这里，是想把昨天没有说完的话说清楚。</d>

[Shot 1, continuation] Continue directly from the exact final frame of the previous segment. The same man takes two slow steps toward the window and pauses beside it. Keep the same warm cafe interior, rain on the glass, white car and street lights outside, and the same subdued cinematic color palette. Use a gentle over-the-shoulder camera move without changing the protagonist identity. His voice, room tone, rain, and footsteps remain continuous. <d>[Chinese] 我不是来争论对错的，我只是希望你能听我把这件事讲完。</d>

[Shot 1, ending] Continue directly from the exact final moment of the previous segment. The man stays beside the window, turns slightly back toward the camera, and finishes the conversation with a restrained, thoughtful expression. Keep the same face, clothing, cafe, rain, lighting, lens, and soundscape. End on a steady medium close-up with natural breathing and a short quiet pause after the final sentence. Do not add a title card, subtitles, captions, logos, or written text. <d>[Chinese] 说完这些，我就该走了。谢谢你愿意听我说。</d>
